latents.fact: a record or document that should not exist
latents.item_desc: A {ADJ} document, filed but never meant to be found. Its content raises questions.

latents.fact: the index refers to itself — the catalogue is its own subject
a faint sound of pages turning, though no one is here and no air is moving
a compressed package — sealed years ago, still intact. everything exactly where it was when it was closed. nothing decayed. nothing forgot itself.
latents.item_desc: A sealed {ADJ} container. Its contents are intact. Whatever was inside when it was closed is still inside now, waiting to expand.

latents.fact: a timestamp embedded in a file: the last touch from hands that didn't know they would want this back
a scripting language the archive cannot run — the instructions are correct, the interpreter is gone. the source knows exactly what it meant to do.
a restricted section behind a filing unit on a track
latents.exit_desc: The filing unit slides aside, revealing a sealed archive beyond.
